title: Compliance service and anti-corruption
lead: Who is responsible for countering corruption at the archive, what has been done and which documents of the service are published.

documents.title: Documents of the service
documents.text: The archive's open documents: the regulation on the service, the action plan and the results of the corruption risk analysis.

report.title: Report a violation
report.text: A report of a corruption offence is an official appeal. It is filed through e-Otinish or at the archive's office.
